title: Affine finite free Koszul Hom complex coordinates
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open, $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $n\in\mathbf N$ and $f:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to A$. Let $T$ be associated sheafification followed by transport from $\operatorname{Spec}A$ to $U$. Let $E=T(K_A(f))$, where the Koszul chain complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] is extended to integer cochain degrees by placing chain degree $k$ in degree $-k$. Then $\mathcal Hom_U^\bullet(E,\mathcal O_U[0])$ [def-pur-hom-complex] is isomorphic as an integer-indexed complex to $T(K_A(f)^\vee)$, where the signed dual complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] has differential $(-1)^{k+1}$ times precomposition by $d_{k+1}$. No regularity, augmentation or ideal-generation condition is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the proved generic homComplex_to_single_iso to the sheafified extended Koszul complex and O_U. This explicitly collapses the product Hom terms and proves the differential sign, without any freeness assumption.

Each Koszul term has the finite exterior-power basis of the Finsupp standard basis. Module.Free.of_basis and Module.Finite.of_basis supply the hypotheses of the degreewise finite free signed dual sheafification comparison.

The generic signed module dual specializes definitionally to koszulDualCochainComplex. Compose the two complex isomorphisms. This combination is fully proved in Lean; only the generic affine finite free comparison remains sorry.

theorem affine_koszul_hom_complex_iso
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)) :
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let E := (T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
    Nonempty (homComplex (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf) E
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      (T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualCochainComplex
          (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f))
